reasoning: Recent Texas Senate polling from the last 45 days shows a very close race, with three public polls placing Democrat James Talarico slightly ahead of Republican Ken Paxton by 2 to 5 points, while aggregated polling still leans Republican by about 1 point. Texas’s statewide Cook PVI remains firmly Republican at R+5.6, indicating a GOP-leaning baseline even though current Senate polling is competitive.

sources.name: Texas Tribune / Texas Public Opinion Research
sources.details: Texas Public Opinion Research found James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 45% to 40% among likely voters, a 5-point Democratic lead.

sources.name: Fox News / Beacon Research
sources.details: Fox News poll found Talarico ahead of Paxton 51% to 48% among registered voters, a 3-point Democratic lead.

sources.name: Texas Southern University / Barbara Jordan Public Policy Research and Survey Center
sources.details: Texas Southern University poll found Talarico leading Paxton 47% to 45%, a 2-point Democratic lead.

sources.name: Pollsmax Texas Senate Forecast
sources.details: Polling average for the Texas Senate race shows Republicans narrowly ahead overall, with an average margin of R+0.9.
